name: All Identity logs (Sign-ins, Failures), Cloud Audit Trails (config changes), and Application Error logs MUST go to the Central SIEM to ensure comprehensive breach detection and investigation.
conditionsText: All services that use authentication, cloud storage and applications
requirementTitle: All Identity logs (Sign-ins, Failures), Cloud Audit Trails (config changes), and Application Error logs MUST go to the Central SIEM to ensure comprehensive breach detection and investigation.
requirementDescription: Important security, audit, and application logs must be collected in SIEM the central monitoring platform so the security team can detect attacks, investigate incidents, and understand what happened.
why:
- Security incidents can be detected quickly.
- Investigators have evidence when something goes wrong.
- Suspicious activity can be correlated across multiple systems.
- Regulatory and audit requirements can be met.
- Attackers cannot hide their actions by exploiting gaps between different logging systems
